$comment: Atlanta seeds (D-040). Public calendars only; each is read through robots.txt, the denylist and the noindex/login checks, so a wrong or blocked URL costs one request and shows up as a skip in the dry run. 'verified': true means a live run read the endpoint (dry run 41849155715) or the URL was confirmed in D-039; false means the endpoint was inferred from the site's platform and public search results and has not been opened from the authoring environment (no outbound access). Seeds a site answered with 403, or with no machine-readable feed at all, are enabled: false with the reason in note. Georgia State is left out because the D-037 importer already reads its Localist calendar and PIN.

seeds.name: Fulton County Library System events
seeds.attribution: Listed from the Fulton County Library System public calendar (fulcolibrary.org).
seeds.note: Off (review of the hardening commits): BiblioCommons-hosted library site. dry run 41849155715: crawl_delay_too_long (robots.txt Crawl-delay over 60 s). BiblioCommons documents no public events feed, its terms of use could not be read from the authoring environment, and a Crawl-delay that long on a vendor platform reads as a request not to be crawled. Re-enable only with a published feed (or written permission) from the Fulton County Library System or BiblioCommons; then prefer a feed seed.

seeds.name: DeKalb County Public Library events
seeds.attribution: Listed from the DeKalb County Public Library public calendar (dekalblibrary.org).
seeds.note: Events run on Communico at events.dekalblibrary.org (event pages are /event/<id>). dry run 41849155715: 0 items from the old dekalblibrary.org/events URL. Communico offers an RSS export only when the library has turned it on; discovery picks up its RSS link if present. Unverified: endpoint not opened from the authoring environment.

seeds.attribution: Listed from the Gwinnett County Public Library public calendar (gwinnettpl.org).
seeds.note: Events run on Communico at gwinnettpl.libnet.info (event pages /event/<id>). dry run 41849155715: 0 items from gwinnettpl.org/events. As for DeKalb, Communico's RSS export exists only if the library enabled it. Unverified.

seeds.note: DeKalb County's Drupal events calendar (public meetings and Recreation, Parks and Cultural Affairs programs). dry run 41849155715: 0 items from /parks. No iCal export confirmed; reads schema.org markup and any feed links. Unverified.

seeds.name: Atlanta BeltLine events
seeds.attribution: Listed from the Atlanta BeltLine public events calendar (beltline.org).
seeds.note: BeltLine's calendar is The Events Calendar for WordPress (its /events/list/, /events/month/ and /events/category/ URLs), whose documented list export is ?ical=1. dry run 41849155715: 0 items from the HTML page, so this reads the export directly. Endpoint unverified.

seeds.name: High Museum of Art events

seeds.note: dry run 41849155715: 0 items, no errors: no schema.org events or feed links on high.org/events (tickets run on Tessitura at high.org/tnew). No public machine-readable feed found. Off until one is.

seeds.name: Atlanta History Center events

seeds.note: The Events Calendar (ECP 6.x) site. dry run 41849155715: 18 items from schema.org markup. /events/feed/ gave 500 and /feed/ is disallowed in robots.txt; discovery now prefers the page's ?ical=1 export when it is linked and skips per-event exports.

seeds.note: dry run 41849155715: 0 items, no errors from fernbankmuseum.org/events. No public machine-readable feed found. Off until one is.

seeds.name: Georgia Tech public calendar
seeds.attribution: Listed from the Georgia Tech public events calendar (calendar.gatech.edu).
seeds.note: Georgia Tech category RSS index (URL from D-039). dry run 41849155715: 0 items, no errors: its RSS items carry no event times, which the RSS reader requires. The campus calendar's 'Get Events' export has no confirmed ICS URL. Off until Institute Communications gives one; then add it as kind ics.

seeds.name: Emory University public calendar
seeds.attribution: Listed from the Emory University public events calendar (events.emory.edu).
seeds.note: Emory's calendar is Trumba (Emory Communications web guide). dry run 41849155715: 0 items from the HTML page, which is rendered by Trumba's script. Trumba publishes ICS/RSS at trumba.com/calendars/<web name>.ics, but Emory's web name is not public; off until Emory Communications (theweb@emory.edu) gives it (D-039), then switch to kind ics.

seeds.name: Kennesaw State University public calendar
seeds.attribution: Listed from the Kennesaw State University public events calendar (calendar.kennesaw.edu).
seeds.note: Localist (confirmed by dry run 41849155715: 351 items from pages, plus /event/*/confirm and calendar.google.com links that are now skipped). Reads Localist's documented read-only API (/api/2/events, no key; developer.localist.com/doc/api) instead of crawling. Academic-calendar deadlines are dropped. Terms: the developer docs say reading needs no key, but Concept3D help says API use needs a license; Kennesaw State is the licensee and the data is public, but ask Kennesaw State for permission as D-037 does for Georgia State, and switch back to kind page if they say no.

seeds.note: CivicPlus iCalendar page (URL confirmed in D-039; dry run 41849155715: 32 items). It lists one /common/modules/iCalendar/iCalendar.aspx?catID=... feed per calendar, which discovery follows.
